caption: The image shows a rectangular fabric piece with a central depiction of a human figure. The outer border is a reddish-brown color, inside which there is a narrower border in a mustard yellow shade. The innermost section contains the figure on an off-white background. The figure is dressed in a blue coat with white striping details, blue pants with vertical white and blue stripes, and black shoes. The head is light-colored with facial features, including eyes and a mustache, drawn in dark lines. The figure is wearing a black, bicorne-style hat. The bottom portion of the inner rectangle features a brown patterned area, suggesting a textured surface for the figure to stand on. Altogether, the piece is composed of appliqué fabric work and embroidery, with distinct color segmentation for the background, borders, and figure.
title: Pillow top Insert
